shared_elements: script signs / glyphic writing covering the surface
stylised faces or heads incorporated into the sign system
curvilinear schematic motifs in low relief/outline
justification: Both are round-topped stelae bearing dense non-alphabetic sign systems with schematic faces embedded in the glyphs, but that is a generic correspondence. B has a clearly organised lunette scene (standing figures with raised arms facing an offering table under a rayed disc) over ruled horizontal text registers, while A shows only large interlocking curvilinear mask-and-scroll motifs with no figural scene, no disc, and no register lines.
